name: Sports bet prophet
tagline: A research desk for bettors: two-leg doubles in a set price band, wager left to you
description: Public odds get shopped and compared while it hunts two-leg doubles inside a stated price band, applying firm pass rules and a hard stop instead of chasing long shots. Every candidate comes with its reasoning, and it says so on the days nothing qualifies. Nothing is placed for you; the wager stays on your phone.
author: SGBackWoods
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
